turns.text: Hey, I really need to talk. Got a moment?
Of course, Sarah. I'm here for you. What's on your mind?
I had my performance review yesterday, and it didn't go as well as I hoped.
I'm sorry to hear that. What did your boss say?
She said my work was 'adequate,' but I was hoping for something more positive.
It's tough not getting the feedback you were expecting, especially when you put in so much effort.
Yeah, it just made me question if I'm even doing a good job.
It's understandable that you're feeling this way. This doesn't define your worth or capabilities.
I know, but after the whole incident with my old boss, I'm just on edge about everything.
That was such a difficult time for you. It's normal for these feelings to resurface.
And I keep thinking about how my friend is doing. I don't want to burden them with my stuff.
You're such a caring person, Sarah. It's okay to focus on yourself too.
Thanks, I just hope this doesn't affect my relationship with Jack. We've had our ups and downs.
Remember, Jack cares about you a lot. It's important to communicate how you're feeling.
I think I'll talk to him tonight. Being open seems to help us a lot.
That sounds like a great idea. How about the painting hobby you started? Is that helping?
It does help. It's nice to have a creative outlet, even if it's just for a bit.
That's wonderful to hear. Taking time for yourself can really make a difference.
Yeah, I just have to remind myself of that. Thank you for listening and just being here.
Anytime, Sarah. I'm really proud of how you're handling everything.
That means a lot. I'll try to take things one step at a time.
Exactly. You've got this, and I'm always here if you need to talk.
